li.label: mage
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was not born with magic - [PAWN_pronoun] took it in, through rituals or long years near living magic. Such mages learn their runes from books and keep them there; they hold more, and cast slower. An arcane core sits in [PAWN_possessive] brain, and the gift remembers it: should the core be lost, it grows back.

li.label: sorcerer
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born with magic. Some runes of [PAWN_possessive] own path come to [PAWN_objective] without study, and [PAWN_pronoun] casts quickly - best within that path. An arcane core sits in [PAWN_possessive] brain, and the gift remembers it: should the core be lost, it grows back.

HediffDef.label: arcane core
HediffDef.description: The seat of a mage's magic in the brain. It holds the Arcana; the stronger the core, the more it holds. Held well, the Arcana sits between two edges: too much, and it presses outwards and swells the mage's sense of greatness; too little, and the mage grows hollow and weak - though never quite ordinary again.

HediffDef.label: greatness
HediffDef.description: Arcana held past what the mage can bear presses outwards - and inwards, into the mind: a growing certainty of being more than everyone else. It fades while the Arcana sits within its edges. The greater it grows, the more work the mage holds beneath them: first cleaning, then hauling and the fields, at last all plain labour and mining.

HediffDef.label: arcane hollowness
HediffDef.description: Too little Arcana for the core that holds it: the mage feels emptied, slow of mind and body. It passes once the Arcana is filled back within its edges.

li.label: a sense of greatness
li.description: There is more to me than to them. I can feel it.

li.label: swelling greatness
li.description: They are so small. Why do they not see it?

li.label: blinded by my own power
li.description: Everything bends to me. Everything should.

li.label: arcana running low
li.description: Something is missing. I need to fill it.

li.label: hollow
li.description: I am empty. Ordinary. I cannot bear it.

li.label: emptied of arcana
li.description: Nothing left. I need it back - now.

MentalStateDef.label: arcane overflow
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {0} holds more Arcana than [PAWN_pronoun] can bear. It pours out of [PAWN_objective] in pulses - anything near may be burnt - until it is down within its edges.
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0} has poured out enough Arcana and is calm again.

MentalStateDef.label: arcane influx
MentalStateDef.baseInspectLine: Arcane influx: lost in own radiance
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: Too weak a hold on too much Arcana: it has turned inwards, into [PAWN_possessive] mind. {0} stands rapt in [PAWN_possessive] own power, and [PAWN_possessive] greatness swells, until the Arcana sinks back within its edges.
